items.detail: Unlocks late in the story.

items.detail: The final hit has to be the kill.

items.detail: Unlocks late in the story.

Read the diary hidden in a Canada mission

categories.name: Completion goals
categories.note: The big milestones for a full file.

items.name: All 102 collectibles
items.detail: 68 crates, 20 bottles and 14 Nightmare Doors.

items.name: Adaptation Level 10
items.detail: Max out Logan's adaptations.

items.name: Hit Rage Tier 3
items.detail: Fill the rage meter all the way.

items.name: Reach player level 36
items.detail: Finishing the story gets you close; replay missions for the rest.

items.name: Clear the secret 15th Nightmare Trial
items.detail: Bronze or better on all 14 trials opens it after the story.

items.name: Earn an Adamantium rating in a Nightmare Trial
items.detail: Any one trial is enough.

items.name: Start New Game+
items.detail: Unlocks after the story.

items.name: Unlock every standard suit
items.detail: Craft 20 standard suits for the trophy. Deluxe Edition suits don't count. Some guides count 17 craftable.

items.name: Unlock the whisky reward suit
items.detail: Your prize for all 20 bottles.

items.name: Own all 27 base-game suits
items.detail: 32 with the 5 Digital Deluxe suits. Crafting needs about 3,500 materials in all, and each crafted suit raises max health.

items.name: Earn the Gold-rank Nightmare Gauntlet suit
items.detail: Comes with its own claws.

items.name: Earn the Adamantium-rank Nightmare Gauntlet suit
items.detail: The toughest suit unlock. Comes with its own claws.

items.name: Win the 3 Nightmare Door claw sets
items.detail: Silver rank or better on single gauntlets.

items.name: Collect all 26 claw sets
items.detail: 23 come with suits, 3 from Nightmare Doors.

items.name: Unlock the end-game suit
items.detail: Guides tie it to finishing the story or 100% completion.

items.name: Every trophy
items.detail: 42 trophies, none missable. Difficulty doesn't matter.
